admission.justification: The retirement boundary, the receipt debt writer, the recovery cursor and the existing observation loop realize the rule across four files.

applicability: A leaf or modern series closing while the host is unreachable or a call fails, and every later observation or cleanup retry.
conditions: The debt head stays in the launch receipt and the serving lifetime's archive recovery loop settles it when the host answers.
While a task folder remains to be removed, unresolved owed debt stops deletion and names the owed seat rather than deleting the folder over a live seat.
exclusions: No second queue, timer, scheduler or fallback is created.
A person is not required to settle the debt once the host is reachable.

evidence: Frozen sourcebeb9473e +8a9894a4/f5ee11cc; test_predecessor_debt_survives_host_failure_and_automatic_recovery_advances_it, test_debt_write_failure_recovers_from_terminal_truth_after_restart, test_existing_observer_archives_terminal_debt_without_a_person_calling_recovery, test_host_budget_and_receipt_settlement_stay_bounded_at_two_scales, test_automatic_scan_is_bounded_and_does_not_starve_the_tail; durable post-sync/full-focused-final.log (157 passed), pyright-final.log (0 diagnostics); complete real-host witness remains pending. Rule8 also has unchanged role launch/repeat/message regressions in the same focused selection.

statement: Host failure or deadline exhaustion leaves truthful receipt-owned predecessor and own-target debt, the serving lifetime's archive recovery loop recovers that debt automatically from terminal truth, and terminal cleanup or abandon blocks folder deletion while any owed seat remains.
title: Archive debt stays in receipts, retries itself, and blocks folder deletion
